verdict.rationale: Shopify documents push webhooks to a registered endpoint whenever an agent-placed order has a committed change, covering fulfillment progress, refunds, returns, exchanges, order edits and cancellations. Deliveries carry full order state, are HMAC-SHA256 signed, and are retried up to 8 times over 4 hours. However, subscription is not programmatic: there is no self-serve subscription API, setup requires contacting a Shopify partner manager, and the UCP profile webhook_url field is not honored. Missing for 10: self-serve or programmatic subscription, an explicitly documented order-created event, and hands-on or independent verification of webhook delivery.
